brand_goods_desc: means goods that carry a brand or licensed design, whether genuine branded goods or imitations. Shipping takes about 3-4 weeks
calc_by_size_and_weight: * Based on the size and weight of the parcel box *
calc_heavy_full: the expected weight = heavy goods: the per-kilogram shipping rate is used
calc_light_full: the expected weight = light goods: the per-cubic-meter shipping rate is used
calc_step1_desc: Multiply the width, length and height of the box (in centimeters), then divide by 1 million to get the size in cubic meters
calc_step1_title: Find the size in cubic meters
calc_step2: Multiply the cubic meters by 200 to find the weight the parcel should have
calc_step3: The result of step 2 is the weight a parcel of this size should have (we call it the 'expected weight')
calc_step4: Compare the actual weight with the expected weight
calc_two_ways: Shipping fees can be calculated in 2 ways
calc_use_cbm_rate: the per-cubic-meter shipping rate is used
calc_use_kg_rate: the per-kilogram shipping rate is used
conditions_declare_type_1: Please declare the product type truthfully and accurately. To protect customers' interests and keep shipments smooth, fast and on schedule, we need to state clearly the product types shipped in each round, so that goods can be cleared through customs quickly and work can proceed efficiently and smoothly
conditions_declare_type_2: If the customer does not inform us, or the information is unclear, the principal company will first inspect by opening the packaging to sort those goods and materials before sending them on to Thailand
conditions_declare_type_3: If the principal company sorts goods into the wrong type, that shipping round will be delayed and may be fined. The owner of those goods must therefore bear sole responsibility for all resulting damage
conditions_force_majeure: In addition, if any other force majeure event occurs that the rules and responsibilities above do not cover, and an inspection finds that the error was solely BTC Cargo's fault, BTC Cargo will compensate for the actual damage, up to a maximum of 3,000 baht
conditions_intro: To protect customers' interests and keep operations running smoothly, please read BTC Cargo's rules and responsibilities carefully. If anything is unclear or you have questions, contact us on LINE @btccargo or by email at ttxbtc@gmail.com. Once any transaction takes place between a customer and BTC Cargo, BTC Cargo will consider that the customer has read and agreed to every one of BTC Cargo's rules and responsibilities
conditions_ordering_1: BTC Cargo only acts as an intermediary, coordinating with Get Ta Yuan Co., Ltd. to use an online platform to order goods and materials from China as the customer requires. BTC Cargo therefore has no policy of opening customers' packaging (unless the goods or materials are opened for inspection at Chinese or Thai customs, or Get Ta Yuan Co., Ltd. cannot tell for certain which customer the goods or materials belong to, in which case the contents will be opened and checked). If the website, wholesaler or factory in the transaction sends the wrong colour, size or quantity and the customer does not inform Get Ta Yuan Co., Ltd. by the day after receiving the goods, Get Ta Yuan Co., Ltd. cannot accept responsibility for any resulting damage
conditions_ordering_2: If the website, wholesaler or factory in the transaction ships the wrong colour, size or quantity, BTC Cargo is happy to coordinate with Get Ta Yuan Co., Ltd. to negotiate with that website, wholesaler or factory. However, BTC Cargo and Get Ta Yuan Co., Ltd. cannot compensate for any damage on behalf of that website, wholesaler or factory
conditions_ordering_3: If an inspection finds that a defect in the shipment was caused solely by BTC Cargo, BTC Cargo will compensate for the actual damage, up to a maximum of 3,000 baht
conditions_ordering_title: Ordering goods and materials from China through websites, wholesalers and factories
conditions_prohibited: Sharp objects, illegal goods, prohibited goods, restricted goods, plants, and all kinds of chemicals and liquids are not accepted for shipping under any circumstances
conditions_shipping_1: BTC Cargo is only a carrier of goods and materials within Thailand; a principal company ships the goods or materials to BTC Cargo for sorting and delivery. Therefore, if factors beyond our control arise, such as accidents, disasters, strict inspections at Chinese or Thai customs, or anything else that delays the shipment, BTC Cargo cannot pay monetary compensation. BTC Cargo will, however, track the status of the goods and materials or try to resolve the problem as quickly as it can
conditions_shipping_2: Shipping special goods or materials, such as sharp objects, controlled goods, prohibited goods, illegal goods, copyrighted goods, TIS-regulated goods, electronic devices, plants, all kinds of chemicals and liquids, and others as announced by each authority and locality of each country at the time, must be reported to BTC Cargo every time. If this is not reported before ordering and it causes shipping delays, or causes any damage to other customers' goods in the same container, or if an employee is injured at work because of the customer's goods or parcels, the customer who shipped those goods or materials alone bears full responsibility for the problems and accidents affecting the customers and BTC Cargo employees concerned, or as set out in BTC Cargo's rules and responsibilities in force on that day
conditions_shipping_3: For special goods such as controlled goods, prohibited goods, illegal goods, copyrighted goods, TIS-regulated goods, electronic devices, plants, all kinds of chemicals and liquids, and others as announced by each authority and locality, that are shipped without informing BTC Cargo first, or that are found to have been seized by customs after being sent to Thailand, as well as any problem that may arise for any reason at Thai or Chinese customs, the customer who shipped those goods or materials must accept the outcome without dispute, and the company cannot compensate for the lost goods
conditions_shipping_4: Customers who use only the service of shipping goods or materials to Thailand must follow the transit status of those goods or materials closely. If a check of the tracking number in China shows that the goods or materials reached the destination because someone signed for them, but our team in China has not yet received them, the customer must follow up with the website, shop or factory themselves, and BTC Cargo cannot compensate for any damage
conditions_shipping_5: BTC Cargo cannot accept responsibility for boxes that are dented or crushed out of shape. However, BTC Cargo will investigate and take responsibility where shipping has damaged the goods or materials inside and the customer is affected. If the fault lies with the website, wholesaler or factory the customer dealt with, whether because the packaging was not strong enough, was poorly packed or could not fully protect the goods, compensation follows the agreement between that website, wholesaler or factory and the customer, and we are happy to coordinate. If the fault lies solely with BTC Cargo, BTC Cargo will compensate for the actual damage, up to a maximum of 3,000 baht
conditions_shipping_6: Goods or materials with a high risk of breakage and damage, including fragile goods, need special care in shipping, for example goods that are or contain liquids, ceramics, machinery, steel and furniture. If the customer has not asked the shop or factory to pack them in a wooden crate, or asked our team in China to crate them, BTC Cargo will not compensate for any damage, unless an inspection finds that the damage was caused solely by BTC Cargo, in which case BTC Cargo will compensate for the actual damage, up to a maximum of 3,000 baht
conditions_shipping_7: If goods or parcels have arrived in Thailand and the customer does not arrange delivery for more than 7 days, counting from the first day of arrival in Thailand, title to and ownership of those goods or parcels pass to the company immediately, and the company may sell them to cover the damage it has incurred, without dispute
conditions_shipping_8: The company is responsible for delivering parcels according to the tracking numbers listed in the delivery order. If the goods received have any problem or defect, the customer must contact the shop or factory only, unless the parcel received does not match the tracking number in the delivery order. Therefore, after receiving a parcel, the recipient must always record a clear video of the unboxing, without moving the camera away and/or editing, to use as evidence for inspection. If there is no unboxing video, or the video is unclear, moves away or has been edited, the company reserves the right to investigate and cannot accept responsibility in any case
conditions_shipping_9: Transit times from China to Thailand, by truck and by ship, may be longer than usual. Shipping by truck normally takes 3-10 days to reach Thailand, and shipping by ship normally takes 30-45 days, counted from the departure date from China in the Chinese-side database. Delays may arise from the situation at customs, traffic conditions affecting transport, government shipping requirements or restrictions, and natural disasters that may occur at the time. These are factors beyond the company's control, and the company cannot accept responsibility for such problems in any case
conditions_shipping_title: Shipping goods and materials from China
delivery_actual_cost: The company charges the actual shipping cost billed by each carrier

general_goods_desc: means ordinary goods that are not electrical appliances, food, medicine or cosmetics, and that carry no brand or licensed design. Shipping takes about 5-9 days
goods_type_note: *Shipping times do not include the wait for goods to reach the China warehouse or any force majeure events that may occur

invoice_cond_1: The goods must be sent separately to the warehouse that issues sales bills, which is a different warehouse from the one in our system
invoice_cond_2a: You must pay for the goods in yuan through us only. For the goods payment, we first issue a deposit bill so that the customer pays for the goods up front.
invoice_cond_2b: Once the parcel arrives in Thailand, we spread the goods cost across the shipping fee and deduct the deposit the customer paid at first
invoice_cond_3: The customer must tell us what goods each tracking number contains, their price in yuan and their quantity. We will issue the bill in as much detail as the customer provides
invoice_cond_4a: * The customer will not be able to check the parcel status in the system *
invoice_cond_4b: This is because, if the data were in our system, it could be regarded as a shipping service. We therefore cannot let the customer check the parcel status
invoice_cond_5: There is no charge for issuing a tax invoice, and the customer pays the 7% VAT
invoice_intro: The company can issue receipts for parcel shipping fees. However, issuing a sales bill or tax invoice (VAT) comes with a few conditions, as follows
invoice_menu_1: Can BTC Cargo issue a receipt
invoice_outro: Our sales bills are quite detailed, so the process may be a little involved, but it is all to keep the accounting and the service in good order
invoice_title: Can BTC Cargo issue a receipt or a tax invoice?
pallet_desc: The company can crate parcels in wood once they reach the China warehouse. Customers can see the service rates and conditions in the "Account overview" menu. That said, we recommend asking the shop to crate the parcel beforehand, to prevent damage on the way to the warehouse
provincial_admin_helps: The warehouse admin will check and find a suitable carrier for the customer
provincial_dispatch_queue: Dispatch follows the payment-notification queue. Orders that miss the cut-off go out in the next day's round
provincial_fee: There is a service fee (including help with repair and repacking) of 100 baht per trip to the carrier, with no limit on the number of parcels
provincial_pay_on_delivery: Shipping within Thailand is paid by the customer to the courier, starting at 100 baht per piece
special_mixed: If general goods are mixed with licensed goods, everything is charged as licensed goods
special_note_1: Sending a parcel that contains FDA-regulated or licensed goods means you accept the possible risks and all shipping conditions without dispute
special_note_2: Shipping this kind of goods carries the risk that customs will remove some of the goods or that all of them will be lost, and we cannot arrange to get them back. If more than 5 items inside the box or sack are lost, or all of them are lost, we cannot accept responsibility in any case
special_note_3: Because this kind of shipping is high-risk, we always watch for a suitable shipping window to avoid such problems. However, we cannot foresee or accept responsibility for accidents or other force majeure events that may occur
status_intro: Data for parcels that have reached the China warehouse is updated in the system every business day in the evening, so customers can check their parcel data the next day
status_step_1: Record the tracking number in the hub.btccargo.com system by choosing the "Create / track parcels" menu, then pressing the "Add new parcel" button
status_step_2: Enter the tracking number and other details, then press Save. The data is saved to the system and the page returns to the main "Create / track parcels" menu
status_step_3: Customers can use the filters to find the parcel they want
status_title: Checking parcel status and adding a new tracking number
storage_fee_1: After a parcel arrives in Thailand, we store it free of charge for up to 5 days.
storage_fee_2: If the customer does not create a delivery bill within 5 days, we charge a storage fee of 10 baht per day until the customer arranges delivery
tis_goods_desc: means electrical appliances with no brand or distributor in Thailand, as well as certain toys, and materials and equipment related to electricity use. Shipping takes about 5-9 days
title: Frequently asked questions
truck_large_parcels: If the customer has many parcels, or parcels too large and heavy to be lifted by hand, the company will deliver by chartered four-wheel or six-wheel truck, or crane truck, with an additional service fee starting at 2,000 baht. Delivery is available throughout Thailand
